items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: Dick Allen knows in New Orleans.

ctx.x: Do you have her address where I might be able to ride her?

No. I tell you who to get that address from. Uh-huh. From the Jazz Museum. Jazz Museum. Yeah. Somebody has it because they keep in touch with them all the time. In the New Orleans Jazz Club they keep in touch with her. Dick Allen knows in New Orleans. Yeah, I'll ask him.
Yeah. They know how to keep in touch with her.
